svg.aria-label: Oxime, phenylhydrazone, 2,4-DNP hydrazone and semicarbazone of ethanal
svg.title: Oxime, phenylhydrazone, 2,4-DNP hydrazone and semicarbazone of ethanal

g.text: Condensation of C=O with ammonia derivatives (H₂N–Z): oxime, hydrazones, semicarbazone
General: R₂C=O + H₂N–Z → R₂C=N–Z + H₂O (nucleophilic addition, then elimination of water: 'addition–elimination')
